text: Cohomology operations in synthetic HoTT (e.g. Steenrod squares) are constructed as:
choices: Natural transformations H^n(-;𝔽₂)→H^{n+k}(-;𝔽₂) constructed using EHP sequences or cup product structure
explanation: Cohomology operations in HoTT are constructed as maps between Eilenberg-MacLane types.
